finding: A successful runtime receipt is not sufficient unless its source bindings exactly match the committed retained-evidence pipeline and test blobs. The source-lock gate fails closed on source drift, command substitution, unsuccessful totals, incomplete bindings, or deployment-authority escalation.

verification.environment: isolated local Node runtime using byte-identical candidate source

limits: The committed retained-evidence pipeline test itself was not executed in an authenticated repository checkout during this slice.
The source-lock gate validates receipt integrity but does not establish exhaustive workflow enumeration or physical-device audibility.
rollback: Revert the additive source-lock implementation, test, evidence, and queue-update commits. No application path or deployment configuration was modified.
falsification_route: Change either bound source blob, alter the approved command, provide failing TAP totals, omit a required binding, or set deployment authority true; the gate must reject the receipt.
